title: Hyatt and Brigade Group Announce Plans for Two New Hyatt Regency Hotels in Bengaluru
summary: Hyatt and Brigade Group Announce Plans for Two New Hyatt Regency Hotels in Bengaluru The two hotels, together offering 600 rooms, will be part of large-scale mixed-use developments across...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO (October 26, 2026)** –[Hyatt Hotels Corporation](https://www.hyatt.com/en-US/home) (NYSE: H) today announced that Hyatt affiliates have signed management agreements with affiliates of Brigade Group for two new Hyatt Regency hotels in Bengaluru: **Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade Global Park** and **Hyatt Regency Bengaluru on** Brigade’s upcoming integrated township on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road. Together, the hotels are expected to add 600 rooms to Bengaluru’s portfolio in India and reinforce Hyatt's strategic growth in key gateway destinations across the country.


Located within two landmark mixed-use developments by Brigade Group, the hotels are expected to serve the growing demand from business travelers, meetings and events, social celebrations and leisure guests in Bengaluru, one of India's most dynamic economic centers.


**Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade Global Park signed a management agreement with Brigade Estates and Projects Private Limited** , an entity of the Brigade Group. The hotel will be located within Brigade Group's 25-acre Global Park integrated advanced engineering and business ecosystem. Planned with approximately 350 guestrooms and suites, the hotel will offer extensive meeting and event facilities totaling approximately 25,000 square feet, alongside multiple dining destinations designed to cater to business and leisure travelers alike.


**Hyatt Regency Bengaluru on** **Whitefield-Kadugodi Road** **follows the signing of a management agreement with Ananthay Properties Private Limited, an entity of the Brigade Group.** The hotel will be part of a premium mixed-use destination. The hotel is planned to feature approximately 250 guestrooms and suites, extensive food and beverage offerings, and a comprehensive meetings and events program, including a ballroom spanning more than 10,000 square feet alongside a large pre-function area and additional meeting spaces.


Both hotels are expected to feature a range of amenities, including an all-day dining restaurant, specialty restaurant, grab-and-go offering, rooftop bar, pool bar, fitness facilities and flexible event spaces, creating vibrant environments where guests can connect, collaborate and celebrate.


"Bengaluru continues to demonstrate strong demand across business travel, meetings and events, making it a strategic market for Hyatt's brand growth in India," said Vikas Chawla, President, India & Southwest Asia, Hyatt. "The signings of Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade Global Park and Hyatt Regency Bengaluru on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road reflect our continued commitment to expanding Hyatt's brand presence in high-growth destinations across the country. We are pleased to collaborate with Brigade Group on these developments and look forward to welcoming guests with the thoughtful service and experiences that define the Hyatt Regency brand."


“At Brigade, hospitality has always been an integral part of our landmark projects," said Nirupa Shankar, Jt. Managing Director, Brigade Group. “The signing of two Hyatt Regency hotels at our upcoming mixed-use developments represents another important step in strengthening our hospitality portfolio in Bengaluru. Both hotels will be part of larger integrated developments that bring together multiple asset classes, reinstating Brigade’s pioneering approach to creating destinations that add long-term value to the city. We are pleased to continue our association with Hyatt through its globally recognised Hyatt Regency brand and bring it to these two significant Brigade developments.”


These projects further deepen the relationship between Hyatt and Brigade Group, underscoring a shared commitment to developing high-quality hospitality experiences in key growth markets across India.


*The term "Hyatt" is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 83 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the Luxury Portfolio, including Park Hyatt®, Alila®, Miraval®, Impression by Secrets, and The Unbound Collection by Hyatt®; the Lifestyle Portfolio, including Andaz®, Thompson Hotels®, The Standard®, Dream® Hotels, The StandardX®, Breathless Resorts & Spas®, JdV by Hyatt®, Bunkhouse® Hotels, and Me and All Hotels; the Inclusive Collection, including Zoëtry® Wellness & Spa Resorts, Hyatt Ziva®, Hyatt Zilara®, Secrets® Resorts & Spas, Dreams® Resorts & Spas, Hyatt Vivid® Hotels & Resorts, Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts®, and Sunscape® Resorts & Spas; the Classics Portfolio, including Grand Hyatt®, Hyatt Regency®, Destination by Hyatt®, Hyatt Centric®, Hyatt Vacation Club®, and Hyatt®; and the Essentials Portfolio, including Caption by Hyatt®, Unscripted by Hyatt, Hyatt Place®, Hyatt House®, Hyatt Studios®, Hyatt Select, and UrCove. Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit[www.hyatt.com](http://www.hyatt.com/) .


**About Hyatt Regency**


The Hyatt Regency brand is a global collection of hotels and resorts found in more than 245 locations in over 50 countries around the world. The depth and breadth of this diverse portfolio, from expansive resorts to urban city centers, is a testament to the brand’s evolutionary spirit. For more than 50 years, the Hyatt Regency brand has championed fresh perspectives and enriching experiences, while its forward-thinking philosophy provides guests with inviting spaces that bring people together and foster a spirit of community. As a hospitality original, Hyatt Regency hotels and resorts are founded on openness—our colleagues consistently serve with open minds and open hearts to deliver unforgettable celebrations, effortless relaxation and notable culinary experiences alongside expert meetings and technology-enabled collaboration. The brand prides itself on an everlasting reputation for insightful care—one that welcomes all people across all countries and cultures, generation after generation. For more information, please visit[hyattregency.com](http://www.hyattregency.com/) . Follow @HyattRegency on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/HyattRegency/?fref=ts) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hyattregency/?hl=en) , and tag photos with #HyattRegency.


**About Brigade Group:**


Established in 1986, Brigade Group is one of India’s leading property developers with close to four decades of expertise in building positive experiences for all their stakeholders and winning their customers’ trust. Brigade has developed many landmark buildings and transformed skylines across India in the cities of Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mysuru, Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, and GIFT City with developments across Residential, Office, Retail and Hospitality.
